headline.en: Write down the work you are deliberately leaving out.
headline.zh: 把明确不做的工作写下来。

sub.en: negplan gives a coding task a portable Markdown ledger with allowed work, excluded work and the reasons for both. The CLI creates and validates that document, gates proposed diffs against the allowed work, and prints a veto/allow summary with human overrides written back.
sub.zh: negplan 为编码任务提供可携带的 Markdown 台账，记录计划实施、明确排除的工作及原因。CLI 可以创建并校验这份文档，对提议的 diff 按允许范围进行门禁，并输出带人工覆盖回写的否决/允许摘要。

body.en: Each excluded item keeps its rationale.
Markdown can travel with the project.
The validator reports fields that violate the schema.
body.zh: 校验器报告违反 schema 的字段。

title.en: Hold scope creep at the gate
title.zh: 在门禁处拦住范围蔓延

body.en: Diff hunks that cite no allowed entry are held as creep until a human overrides.
body.zh: 未引用允许条目的 diff hunk 会被判为 creep 拦下，直到人工覆盖。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Node.js 22+; parse and validate the complete example ledger, gate a diff with one cited and one uncited hunk, override one veto, and render the summary.
note.zh: 需要 Node.js 22+；解析并校验完整台账示例，门禁一个含引用与未引用 hunk 的 diff，覆盖一个否决项，并输出摘要。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Offline parsing, schema validation and serialization of a complete scope ledger; diff-hunk gating with one cited and one uncited hunk; one human veto override; and the veto/allow summary — the full m1+m2+m3 flow, no network or agent required.

body.en: Node.js 22+; parse and validate the complete example ledger, gate a diff with one cited and one uncited hunk, override one veto or force a held hunk through with negplan override, and render the summary.
body.zh: 需要 Node.js 22+；解析并校验完整台账示例，门禁一个含引用与未引用 hunk 的 diff，覆盖一个否决项或用 negplan override 放行被扣留的 hunk，并输出摘要。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/negplan.git
cd negplan
npm ci
npm run build

limitations.en: The gate matches the will_implement entry cited in each hunk header — it does not understand a diff's semantics, so a well-formed but wrong citation passes.
limitations.zh: 门禁按 hunk 头部引用的 will_implement 条目匹配，不理解 diff 语义，格式正确但引用错误的判定仍会通过。

limitations.en: Validation checks document structure, not whether planned work is appropriate or whether generated code follows it.
limitations.zh: 校验检查文档结构，不判断计划是否合理，也不验证生成代码是否遵守约定。

limitations.en: The table parser is a focused format parser, not a complete Markdown implementation. Keep entries in the supplied table format.
limitations.zh: 表格解析器只支持特定格式，不是完整 Markdown 实现；条目应沿用提供的表格格式。

body.en: An exclusion is easier to discuss when it has an ID and rationale beside the requested work. Keeping the agreement in a file makes it available to a person or any agent that can read Markdown.
body.zh: 排除项与需求并列、带有 ID 和原因时，更容易讨论。把约定保存在文件中，人或能读取 Markdown 的 Agent 都可使用。

body.en: init expands a Markdown template. The parser reads YAML frontmatter and three table sections into a typed ledger; a focused validator checks the shipped schema, and serializeLedger writes the canonical form. gate reads a unified diff on stdin and records allowed/creep verdicts; render prints the veto/allow summary, and override forces a held creep hunk through when the human accepts it.
body.zh: init 展开 Markdown 模板；解析器将 YAML frontmatter 与三个表格章节读成类型化台账，专用校验器检查随仓 schema，serializeLedger 写出规范格式。gate 从 stdin 读取 unified diff 并记录 allowed/creep 判定；render 输出否决/允许摘要，override 在人工接受时放行被扣留的 creep hunk。

body.en: init expands a Markdown template. The parser reads YAML frontmatter and three table sections into a typed ledger; a focused validator checks the shipped schema, and serializeLedger writes the canonical form. gate maps each hunk to the will_implement entry its header cites; applyOverrides moves overridden vetoes into will_implement; overrideGateVerdict marks a held hunk overridden with human_override: true.
body.zh: init 展开 Markdown 模板；解析器将 YAML frontmatter 与三个表格章节读成类型化台账，专用校验器检查随仓 schema，serializeLedger 写出规范格式。gate 将每个 hunk 映射到其头部引用的 will_implement 条目；applyOverrides 把被覆盖的否决项移入 will_implement；overrideGateVerdict 将被扣留的 hunk 标记为 overridden 并写入 human_override: true。

body.en: Choose the input and output route that matches your workflow. The local example below exercises the stated subset.
body.zh: 根据工作流选择输入与输出路径。本文本地示例验证其中明确说明的子流程。

body.en: A ledger starts with task, optional agent/created_at and status (drafting, negotiating, gating or done). will_implement rows contain id, summary and rationale; will_not_implement adds overridden. gates records change_id, file, hunk, entry_id, verdict and human_override for every hunk the gate checks. init --force overwrites an existing file; omit it to preserve an existing agreement.
body.zh: 台账开头包含 task、可选 agent/created_at 与 status（drafting、negotiating、gating 或 done）。will_implement 行含 id、summary、rationale；will_not_implement 还包含 overridden。gates 记录 change_id、file、hunk、entry_id、verdict、human_override，门禁检查的每个 hunk 都会追加一行。init --force 会覆盖已有文件；不加时保留现有约定。

body.en: Run these commands from the repository root after installation. Replace paths for your own data.
body.zh: 安装后在仓库根目录运行以下命令；处理自己的数据时替换相应路径。

details.code:
node dist/src/cli.js init --task "Add CSV export" --output .negplan.md
# Fill the allowed/excluded entries in .negplan.md, then:
node dist/src/cli.js validate --file .negplan.md
# Gate a diff: cite the will_implement entry after the @@ header
printf '+++ b/src/export.ts\n@@ -1,1 +1,2 @@ satisfies w1\n+exportCsv()' | node dist/src/cli.js gate .negplan.md
# Veto/allow summary; override vetoes and write them back
node dist/src/cli.js render .negplan.md
node dist/src/cli.js render .negplan.md --override n2
